title: Agentic RAG over 28,000 documents
summary: Two lawyers, 28,000 documents, no searchable archive. Shipped an agentic retrieval pipeline; eval accuracy rose 20%.

title: Cutting research latency by 26%
summary: Research answers came back slow and document prep ate the week. Cut end-to-end latency 26% and manual prep 70%.

title: A scoring gate for outbound lists
summary: Outbound lists were manual and noisy. Added a scoring gate validated on 150 labelled rows: 658 qualified contacts across 173 companies.
